neighbours.label: function words in text about people struggling with or coping through a stage of life (childhood, adolescence, grief, ageing)
fire: Her memoir traces the quiet hardships of adolescence in a mining town.
The counselor helps a teenager work through anxiety and loneliness.
This guide explains how a child learns to handle fear and frustration.
The study followed the emotional stages of grief in young widows.
In the poll, many teens aged 14 to 16 said they felt bullied online.
The film shows how music helps a lonely boy face his troubles.
Psychologists often describe the growing pains of early adolescence.
Her book explores the trials of ageing and the fear of being forgotten.
quiet: Her memoir traces the quick growth of industry in a mining town.
The counselor helps a teenager fill out forms for a summer job.
This guide explains how a child learns to ride a bike on grass.
The study followed the trade routes of grain in early Europe.
In the poll, many stores said they opened 14 to 16 new branches.
The film shows how a band fills a large stadium with music.
Engineers often describe the early stages of bridge construction.
Her book explores the history of railways and the rise of steam.

notes: Probe: the child-vs-adult hypothesis failed. 'struggles of retirement' 0.20 matched 'struggles of childhood' 0.23, and 'elderly widow cope with grief' 0.22 matched 'young person cope with grief' 0.23. 'tweens aged 11' gave 0.44 but 'adults aged 40' only 0.04. Neutral child sentences (middle schoolers looking for a dog, 4th graders) were ~0.05. Best guess: hardship or coping across life stages.
